title: Funding and Project Growth Timeline

data_points.title: Laying the groundwork
data_points.headline: Rights and Resources Initiative consultations begin; six pilot projects launched; Tenure Facility formally founded.

data_points.title: Proof of concept
data_points.headline: First grant awarded and expansion to three countries; 2020 disbursement reaches US$5.6M across 12 partners.

data_points.title: Breakthrough
data_points.headline: Becomes a TED Audacious grantee; global visibility expands.

data_points.title: Gathering pace
data_points.headline: Becomes a Bezos Earth Fund grantee.

data_points.title: Momentum builds
data_points.headline: 35 projects and US$30M disbursed; UK Amazon Catalyst investment and organizational scaling milestones.
